# GitHub Configuration and Templates

This directory houses community and contributor automation templates for the **Classroom Platform** repository.

## Purpose of this Directory

* Provides issue templates to standardize bug reports, feature requests, and technical specifications.
* Provides a pull request template to enforce architectural checklist compliance and domain tagging.

## What Belongs Here

* Issue templates (`ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`)
* Pull request templates (`PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`)
* Workflow documentation and contribution automation guides

## What Does NOT Belong Here

* Executable CI/CD pipeline scripts or workflow actions (these will be added when build tools are configured)
* Application source code or environment keys
